pose.title: Counterturn:
pose.text: Turn the hips away from an implied attack while the shoulders return toward it, with the weapon held in a compact counter guard; show readiness without an extreme twist or crouch.

pose.title: Outside Ward:
pose.text: Set a cutting weapon outside the near shoulder with its point angled down and outward; turn the torso slightly while the free hand remains ready.

pose.title: Wrist Clasp:
pose.text: One hand gently clasps the opposite wrist at waist level; distribute weight evenly and keep the expression calm.

pose.title: Tiny Ta-Da:
pose.text: Present a small object in an open palm beside the torso; turn the shoulders and lift the chin as if revealing a trick.

pose.title: Temple Tap
pose.text: Touch one finger to the temple while the other hand holds notes low; keep the spine slightly inclined in thought.

pose.title: Cuff Hold
pose.text: One hand lightly holds the opposite sleeve cuff near the waist; tilt one hip slightly lower and keep the standing pose contained.

pose.title: Grounded Brace:
pose.text: While standing, rest one palm on a nearby standing-height desk, ledge, or table below the frame; lean forward slightly while keeping the hips grounded.

pose.title: Hand to Heart:
pose.text: Place one hand over the heart while the other rests low or holds a prop; use an open chest and gentle posture.

pose.title: Shared-Object Presentation:
pose.text: Support a book, tray, or sample with both hands in front of the waist; turn the shoulders toward the viewer in an inviting gesture.

pose.title: Command Fold:
pose.text: Fold the arms firmly but comfortably across the chest; angle the hips slightly and keep the shoulders level.

pose.title: Chin-Brace:
pose.text: Rest fingertips at the chin while the other forearm supports the elbow; let one hip relax as the character considers a question.

pose.title: Point of Order:
pose.text: Raise one finger, pen, or wand beside the chest as if making a decisive point; hold the other arm relaxed.

pose.title: Cheek in Palm:
pose.text: While standing, support the cheek with one palm as the opposite forearm supports that elbow, or rest the elbow lightly on a standing-height ledge; keep the other arm loose.

pose.title: Cheeky Shrug:
pose.text: Raise one shoulder and open both palms at different heights; shift the hips sideways in a playful “who, me?” stance.

pose.title: Fist Pump:
pose.text: Raise one compact fist beside the shoulder and keep the other hand at the waist; add a small twist through the hips.

pose.title: Hip Anchor:
pose.text: Set one hand on the hip with the elbow open; shift weight onto that side and lengthen the spine.

pose.title: Lean-In Listener:
pose.text: Angle the torso toward an unseen conversation partner, with one hand near the cheek or collar and the hips relaxed.

pose.title: Cross-Body Swing:
pose.text: Sweep one forearm across the torso while the other arm balances; counter-rotate the shoulders and hips.

pose.title: Finger to Lips:
pose.text: Touch one fingertip lightly near the lips; tip the head and hip in opposite directions for a sly, contained gesture.

pose.title: Cuff Hold:
pose.text: One hand lightly holds the opposite sleeve cuff near the waist; tilt one hip slightly lower and keep the standing pose contained.

pose.title: Chin-Brace:
pose.text: Rest fingertips at the chin while the other forearm supports the elbow; let one hip relax as the character considers a question.

pose.title: Open Claim:
pose.text: Extend one arm outward with an open palm, as if claiming the room; counterbalance with a small hip shift.

pose.title: Over-Shoulder Tease:
pose.text: Turn the torso away and glance back over one shoulder; add a small hand flick or lifted wrist.

pose.title: Forward Challenge:
pose.text: Shift weight forward and angle the torso into the scene; set the shoulders ready without beginning an attack.

pose.title: Wrist Clasp:
pose.text: One hand gently clasps the opposite wrist at waist level; distribute weight evenly and keep the expression calm.
